messages:
eva: Noticing a jump in both SAST and DAST flaky failures after the infra RBAC pruning landed. CI shows a bunch of KMS AccessDenied on artifact unwrap and a few auth failures in staging. Blocking a few release PRs. Anyone tracking?
sec-bot: alert: `scan-orchestrator` failures=62 fail_ratio=0.22 delta=+16% recent_errors=["KMS:AccessDenied", "http:401"] run: https://ci.internal/runs/9092
marco: I think the infra change switched scanner SA to assume `security-scan-role` (sts). KMS key policy still lists the old service account principal `serviceAccount:scanner@redwood`. That would explain Decrypt denies.
sandra: Can you paste a concrete log line? Also are these coming from SAST or DAST or both?
eva: sample: ```2024-02-14T04:12:11Z scan-orch ERROR unwrap artifact=gh-20412 error=AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::222222222:assumed-role/security-scan-role/scanner is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222222:key/ef12-3456``` both SAST and DAST jobs hit artifact unwrap; DAST also had a couple 401s when fetching staging credentials.
tom: Quick mitigation: we should not turn scans off. Propose temporary CI soft-fail for the `scan` jobset and a parallel fix on key policy. I'll open the waiver.
infra-oncall: Waiver created: scan-suite soft-fail for 90m (id=WAIV-20240214-07). Keep me posted before expiry.
yara: Who can edit KMS key policy? I can if someone confirms the correct principal to add. Marco, confirm the assumed-role ARN?
marco: It's `arn:aws:sts::222222222:assumed-role/security-scan-role/scanner`. Also consider adding the IAM role ARN `arn:aws:iam::222222222:role/security-scan-role` to key policy so both assume styles covered.
sandra: Long-term: we should detect key-policy drift as part of role-change PRs. Short-term: add `kms:Decrypt` for the role to the key policy. I'll patch in staging and run decrypt smoke tests.
eva: Also we saw a lot of false positives from a new pattern-matching rule `long-hex-seq` in SAST catching UUID-ish blobs in generated clients. Can we whitelist `gen/*.pb.go` and adjust severity?
yara: Patch applied in staging. Test decrypt: ```aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222222:key/ef12-3456 --profile staging-scan``` returned plaintext.
marco: Re-ran subset of failing pipelines: artifact unwraps fixed, DAST 401s reduced (was an unrelated token expiry issue), SAST still flags `long-hex-seq` in a couple repos.
tom: Benign rule hits should be suppressed via repo-level config. I'll add a lightweight suppression template and link to a PR.
sec-bot: created incident: "scan-surge-kms-policy-mismatch" id=INC-20240214-02 link: https://inc.internal/INC-20240214-02
sandra: Action list: 1) remove hardblock by keeping soft-fail waiver (tom) 2) patch KMS key policy in prod after staging validation (yara) 3) add CloudTrail filter/alert for `kms:Decrypt` AccessDenied spikes (marco) 4) open SAST heuristic tuning ticket (tom) 5) add RBAC->KMS preflight check to infra change template (eva)
infra-oncall: I'll authorize prod key policy change after staging validated artifact runs: please paste proof.
yara: Prod patch staged, smoke decrypt succeeded with sample artifact, will rollout after 15m.
marco: For alerting, I'll add a CloudWatch metric filter for `KMS:Decrypt` failure events and a Lambda to tag a CI run with the error and point to the infra PR; will also add a Grafana panel showing key-level denies.
tom: Opened PR for SAST config and suppression template: https://git.internal/sast-config/pull/78 (includes gen/* whitelist + severity adjust + example test).
eva: I'll update the scan-runbook: include a new section 'RBAC changes -> KMS key policy checklist' with commands, smoke-test steps, and rollback pointers. Also a preflight script in infra repo to scan key policies for principals being removed.
sec-bot: alert resolved: scan-orchestrator failures decreased to baseline. note: WAIV-20240214-07 expires in 35m.
yara: Prod key policy live and decrypt smoke passed against a handful of archived artifacts.
sandra: We'll keep the heuristic ticket low-effort (tweak + small test) and track runbook + preflight work as infra tasks. Thanks folks.
eva: Filing short postmortem and linking tickets. Will include timeline: RBAC prune -> assumed-role mismatch with KMS key principal -> artifact decrypt denies -> scan surge -> CI soft-fail waiver -> key-policy patch -> heuristic tuning -> runbook + preflight automation.
